name: Hiraizumi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hiraizumi town emblem in maroon: a stylised device of a curved stroke and a peaked upper part, like a bird.
history: Municipal flag of Hiraizumi, a town in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 May 1965.

features.role: Hiraizumi town emblem — a stylised device of a curved stroke and a peaked upper part, like a bird
